user_authorization: Track small gains as possible additions and test to validate; previously authorized sequential then combined trials.
settings: Same Qwen3.8-Flash-Next Q2_0/packed shared Q3 helper, mixed placement,8helperCPUworkers,depth3/confidence0,TensorAPIon,F16/4K/batch512,temp0.6/seed1234; short English code/prose and complete contextual long English code/prose; cached512/2048 remain separate.
independent_unit: Fresh process launch. Median of three repetitions within launch; average the two launch medians per arm. Raw within-launch and between-launch variation retained. No statistical significance or confidence-interval claim from two launches per arm.

new_gate.metric_gain: Positive aggregate benefit strictly above twice absolute own control drift; BOTH candidate launch medians beat BOTH control launch medians on that metric.
new_gate.regression: For TTFT, whole reply and generationTPS, loss greater than max(1percent,twice own control drift) blocks that workload scope.
new_gate.general_scope: Same metric must qualify on both English code and prose; each requires all resource/parity/activation gates. Otherwise report named workload-only benefit.
new_gate.confirmation: First all three independent screens; passing general candidates get exactly one new independent confirmation ABBA. No performance retry if noisy/negative.
new_gate.combined: Freeze only candidates whose same metric qualifies in BOTH new brackets; select newprofile before fresh combinedABBA. Cover short cohort for decode candidates and long cohort for compact. One feature subset only, no searching combinations.
new_gate.memory: No new swap,healthy monitor,exact outputs including warmups/cache. Extra average processRSS above max(128MiB,twice controlRSS spread) blocks memory-clean label; RSS is not unique totalMetal memory. Record nativebuffers and minimumavailable.
new_gate.activation: Candidate once-only actualencoding markers for each enabledfeature,noneforunselectedfeatures orcontrol. Counts proveencoding notshaderfrequency.
new_gate.cached_policy: Cached512/2048 exact outputs and resource guards mandatory. Cached timing is diagnostic, not primary adoption; flag any loss above max(5percent,twice own drift) for independent follow-up before default promotion.

exclusions: Stop on resource/parity/activation failures, preserve everyrun. At most one full resource-only retry after fresh headroom/quiet preflight; do not pool partialruns or weaken limits. Changed code/fixture requires amended freshplan before further GPU.
historical: Old tests,thresholds,results preserved; newuser-authorized protocol creates newreceipts and never flips oldqualifies flags.
